name: singular-orchestration
description: Operate Singular (CLI: singular) multi-agent orchestration — author DAG plans, run autonomous parallel agent loops, and monitor L0/L1/L2 state through the read-only console/dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Singular agents, plans, tasks and gates with a live dashboard and console viewer.
interface.longDescription: An operator skill plus local console (dashboard/viewer/visualization UI, started idempotently with `singular console --ensure`) for Singular orchestration. The skill teaches an agent to set up a repo, author parallel DAG plans and planner contracts, use the autonomous loop as one way to run the engine, promote gates, and recover stuck runs. The console (0.10.0) is a full-bleed app shell: a left sidebar holds the plan-threads list (the live plan plus archived read-only threads) and an app-level Providers nav, while a slim header carries four thread-scoped tabs: Home (system-at-a-glance landing — health, attention feed, gate progress, 14-day activity, quick links), a Plan workbench over the DAG (execution-timeline Gantt with real per-attempt bars and gate marks, a rebuilt dependency matrix with sticky headers and follow-diagonal scrolling, layered stage graph, task table, node drilldown aside), a Consoles operations room (persistent L0 supervisor stream plus dynamic role/task-labeled agent consoles that collapse to a recent rail), and an Agents role grid with EDITABLE settings (model/effort/concurrency knobs written to singular.config.json env{} with when-it-applies labels). The sidebar's Providers surface (0.9.0) shows every supported agent CLI's install/auth status (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor, Grok — probed via each CLI's own status command; email · plan shown, never secrets) with model knobs and a use-as-default-runner switch. A supervisor presence (0.10.0) surfaces on Home: a periodic read-only LLM briefing plus a propose-only chat where any settings change the model suggests applies only when a human clicks Apply, through the same POST /api/settings whitelist. Provider quota gauges (0.10.0) show subscription usage: Codex's real used-percent and reset window read from its own local session data, tier-only for the rest, never any secret. Developer primitives throughout: role prompt templates and the exact rendered prompt of any run, plus {} view-source buttons exposing the raw durable file behind every entity (tasks, leases, dispatch records, gates, breaker, backoff, config, DAG). Plan threads (0.8.0): when a DAG completes, `singular plan archive` snapshots it as a browsable read-only thread; the sidebar threads list and a Home card let you revisit archived plans chat-style while a fresh plan runs. Orchestration state itself stays read-only. Deployed sub-agents are derived from durable facts only.
defaultPrompt: Run the Singular orchestration on this repo.
